newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper, nickel lose on weak world trends.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper, nickel lose on weak world trends.

text.p: Indian copper and nickel prices on Wednesday suffered losses on weak world trends while zinc gained in local markets, dealers said.
Other base metals remained steady in limited activity.

Copper and nickel prices extended losses on the back of a weak trend in the world market as well as fresh arrivals. Copper slid by 25 rupees at 13,500 rupees per quintal while nickel lost 200 rupees at 33,200 rupees per quintal.
Zinc prices rose by 50 rupees at 8,300 rupees per quintal on the back of speculative buying influenced by a rising world market.
World zinc has risen to a seven-year high. Lead was quiet at 4,150 rupees per quintal, aluminium at 7,700 rupees and tin at 28,500 rupees per quintal amid nominal trading.
Overall volumes slowed down today due to poor attendance among traders following a strike call by a local political party in Bombay.
